strategy_summary: DOAS (DCV, 0.80/0.80 enthalpy wheel with bypass) + radiant ceiling on a 16 C low-lift water-cooled chiller + 7 C water-cooled DOAS chiller, no heating; radiant terminals available only during the ventilation schedule. Radiant loop design temperature difference 5 K.

args.engineering_justification: Catalog values unchanged: BEC 2024 Table 6.12b water-cooled chiller COP 5.5 at 7/32 C; low-lift terminal chiller credited +3.5%/K to 16 C (project literature rule) = 7.2325; fan and pump pressures inherit the active baseline; heat recovery 0.80/0.80 within the 0.80 limit.
args.notes: h09 arguments with the radiant terminal loop at 16/21 C (design temperature difference 5 K instead of 4 K).
args.hvac_availability_schedule_name: ventilation schedule of the baseline model

engineering_basis: Same equipment and catalog parameters as rad_water_water_no_heat with air-side options (h06/h08). Only the terminal availability schedule is set through the toolkit argument hvac_availability_schedule_name; BEC 2024 chiller COP minimum, 8 L/s per person outdoor air with DCV, exhaust-air energy recovery.
rationale: h09 equipment energy: pumps 7.78 kWh/m2 at the fixed baseline head, so pump energy can only fall through flow. The radiant loop design difference of 4 K is below the 5 K the plant rule allows for high-temperature loops; 5 K cuts the design flow of the terminal pump by 20% and, through the chiller's evaporator flow, nothing else. Panel surface temperature rises slightly at the return end. Requested case_id=h10.
